rule: THE INSTRUMENT IS FROZEN from the start line until EVALUATE or FUTILE. A change to anything FROZEN below ENDS THE TEST and restarts it from a new start line: no partial credit, no splicing. Exempt (OUT, each with its reason): display text (DEFINED 2026-11-26, the reviewer: text that does not inform stock selection; text on the Signals tab, the stock screen or the Add form at the moment of choice is NOT display text), the budget bar, tests, guards, documentation, the measurement scripts, anything recorded and unused. A defect found on the frozen path goes to the reviewer, never fixed on the spot.

out.core/execution-mode-count.js: BUDGET BAR: counts positions by execution mode for the bar (exempt: the budget bar)
out.sw.js: THE CACHE: which files the service worker caches, by version; computes nothing
out.data/float-table.json: THIRD-PARTY DATA CACHED IN THE REPO (the reviewer, 2026-11-26): the rule is "float under X", and freezing the table would silently make it "float on 2026-11-22 under X", a different rule that drifts further every week. It refreshes on schedule like prices and bars; its BUILDER is frozen; every rebuild is recorded on the daily line, and an unscheduled one is an intervention

store.reason: THE MUTABLE STORE'S INITIAL VALUES: `state` is rewritten at load from the settings and positions in the database; the settings that reach the frozen path are frozen by VALUE (instrument settings), and the universe scanned each day is in rating_snapshots

display.reason: DISPLAY: renders text, markup or charts from values computed elsewhere; changes what a screen says, not what is scanned, scored, gated, priced or recorded (exempt: display text)

health.reason: HEALTH AND STATUS: build, layout, storage, workflow-health and write-failure readouts, developer tests and force-update; nothing they do reaches a measured quantity

budget.reason: BUDGET AND SIZING: the budget bar and position-size settings (exempt: the budget bar); shares do not enter any per-share return

dialogs.reason: DIALOG PLUMBING: queues and closes dialogs; carries no value into a scan, a score, a gate, a price or a record

portfolioView.reason: PORTFOLIO VIEW: sort and filter of the portfolio list; changes order on screen, not any value

analytics.reason: AFTER THE FACT: analytics, reports and exports that read recorded trades; the sell-timing columns they write (price_at_plus*) are read by no forward-test measure

recordedUnused.reason: RECORDED AND UNUSED: captured into records that no measure reads (exempt)

dead.reason: DEAD CODE: declared and called by nothing in the app (its only occurrence is its own definition); a frozen caller added later would change that caller hash

security.reason: SECURITY: the PIN screen, its hashes and the API-key form; they gate access to the app, not anything it measures

boot.reason: BOOT SCREENS AND LOCAL HOUSEKEEPING: loading and error screens, legacy-key cleanup, clear-all

premarket.reason: PRE-MARKET MOVERS: a separate section above the scan list, with its own AI read; not the scan, its scores or its gates

settings.source: data/backups/settings.json (row 0), backed up daily by backup-tables.yml

out.risk_per_trade_pct: SIZING: shares do not enter a per-share return

settings.why_execution_mode: FROZEN 2026-11-26 (the reviewer): on paper there is no broker, so the recording IS the trade and every app-recorded minute the measures read (buy_date/buy_time, sell_date/sell_time) is exact. Under live, a broker sits between the decision and the fill, every recorded minute becomes an approximation of unknown size, and sell_filled_at has never once been typed (0 entered, 125 default, 783 empty), so nothing would record the difference. A switch to live ENDS THE TEST and restarts it. execution_mode_set_at is frozen with it, so a switch and a switch back cannot pass unseen.
